title: Retired USAF colonel David flies a craft

tellings.quote: And and he just tells a story. I'm on a craft. He says, "I suddenly find myself on a craft."

plain: A retired US Air Force colonel, known only as David, says he once suddenly found himself aboard a craft, and the story goes that he flew it, somewhere in Orange County, California. Grant Cameron passes this on to Michels second-hand, quoting the colonel: 'I suddenly find myself on a craft.' If true, it would mean a human was put at the controls of an unknown vehicle.
